ai-analyze-request/1.segments: Required nonempty array, 1..16 explicit segments. Omission and [] are invalid.
ai-analyze-request/1.status: Availability of original knee and gait metric values.

ai-analyze-request/2.segments: Omit to detect automatic candidates. If present, use a nonempty array of 1..16 explicit segments with the same /1 fields. [] is invalid.
ai-analyze-request/2.gdi: Each segment includes gdi-segment/1 with baseline and normal100 models. Top gdi-summary/1 keeps directions separate in by_direction.
ai-analyze-request/2.status: Each segment counts knee/gait metric values plus both models' left/right GDI values: all available complete, some partial, none unavailable. Top status is complete only if every segment is complete, unavailable for zero segments or all unavailable, otherwise partial. Mixed-direction pooled GDI is null by design; available per-direction values remain in by_direction.
ai-analyze-request/2.empty_frames: Accepted. Automatic detection returns no segments and unavailable with no_source_frames. Explicit bounds return nulls with reasons.

legacy_descriptions: Top request_schema/response_schema/request.required/response.gdi describe /1 compatibility. versions is authoritative for per-version required fields and response shape.

request.pose: measurement-pose/1, as described in pose-contract.json. Unknown extractor variant/runtime/runtime_version/model_sha256/delegate can use literal unknown. Model metadata never entered by end users. Historical runtime_version=null remains accepted and preserved as unknown.

tracking.session_id: nonempty automatically generated string, or unknown
tracking.start_time_ms: finite timestamp or null for unknown; tracker history start
tracking.input_start_ms: finite timestamp or null for unknown; full tracker input lower bound inclusive
tracking.input_stop_ms: finite timestamp or null for unknown; full tracker input upper bound exclusive
tracking.prior_frame_count: nonnegative integer or null; processed frames before first frame included in pose packet
tracking.fresh_tracker: boolean or null; whether a new tracker was created at start_time_ms

request.v2: schema ai-analyze-request/2 permits omitted segments for AI auto-detection. Explicit segments keep the same shape. Empty arrays remain invalid; omit the field to request auto.

validation.unknown_properties: Reject at request/segment/provenance/tracking/pose/image/clock/extractor/frame objects. extractor.settings may contain arbitrary finite strict JSON data.
validation.strict_json: Reject NaN/Infinity, duplicate object keys and non-UTF8. All frame indices/source_time_ms strictly increasing. Finite landmark numbers or null; visibility/presence in 0..1 or null.
validation.geometry: pose.image.orientation must be upright_unmirrored, normalized xy with pixel width/height. preview_mirrored concerns display only. No coordinate clamp or automatic side swap.
validation.unknown: unknown metadata retained in response and comparison_key, comparison.ready=false if required conditions unknown. Unknown travel direction only makes gait output unavailable; knee geometry still runs.
validation.tracking: Known tracking times must be ordered. input_start_ms<=first supplied frame and input_stop_ms>last supplied frame. start_time_ms<=input_start_ms. No inferred 35-frame minimum.
validation.empty: Empty pose.frames is accepted with finite explicit segments; metrics become null with reasons.
validation.segments: Bounds may extend beyond supplied frames and overlaps are permitted. Each segment is sliced independently with original times; no interpolation across segments.

response.execution: Python/platform/dependency versions and source hashes automatically collected by service.
response.provenance: Original image/clock/extractor and request input_object/tracking; never replace unknown values.
response.comparison: ready:boolean,unknown_fields:list,key:structured shared extraction/image/clock/tracker+analysis conditions. Each segment also supplies direction and same anatomical sides. Key agreement means processing-condition agreement.

items.observation: source_frame_count, pose_frame_count, observed_span_ms (0 for <2frames), first/last_source_ms (null when empty), source_indices, provided_prior_frame_count
items.knee: method_id,metrics,quality,views. observed=finite nondegenerate xy; supported=observed+inside image+visibility>=0.5; presence diagnostic only. Metrics retain original unit/value/valid_count/unavailable_reason. views includes curves and simultaneous bilateral summaries.
items.gait: measurement-metrics/1 from fixed native-PTS relative-heel module; unknown direction returns same metric shape with nulls/unknown_direction; source_frames, events, steps, rejected_pairs, quality_reasons included.

response.v2: ai-analysis/2 adds segmentation and actual gdi per segment. Top-level gdi.by_direction keeps image_left/image_right/unknown separate. models summary is provided only for a single known direction; mixed or unknown direction yields null pooled models with explicit reason. Inside each direction, earliest overlapping segment is retained, non-overlapping available segment predictions have equal-weight arithmetic mean. Segment/source/visit personal-history aggregation is not implemented here.
response.gdi_v2: gdi_adapter.analyze_segment(pose,segment) result per segment. gdi summary status available/partial/unavailable; models keyed by baseline/normal100, nested value.left/right with used_segment_ids and aggregation. Never clip scores. Original GDI preprocessing permits at most 25% missing required coordinates and performs its original interpolation; input.required_missing_fraction and feature/source/checkpoint provenance are retained. This differs from auto segmentation, which never bridges excluded frames.
response.segmentation: Automatic output marks candidate status and orientation-derived travel direction. Missing/uncertain/turn/low-motion/short ranges are excluded with source indices and reasons. Pelvis screen displacement is not a direction feature.
response.v1_compatibility: ai-analyze-request/1 continues to require explicit segments and returns ai-analysis/1 with original GDI unconfigured envelope; numerical knee/gait results unchanged.

http.POST /v1/analyze: 200 response even for partial/unavailable measurements. Content-Type application/json required.
http.defaults: 127.0.0.1:8877. CORS only localhost/127.0.0.1. No file paths executed from request. No request-body logging or automatic persistence.

entrypoints.library: from core import analyze; analyze(request_dict) -> response_dict
